annotations.text:
Home page, plan 0003.
Phone only, 390x844. No desktop design is planned for now.
The home route IS the landing page: anonymous visitors get the front door, signed in users get their groups.
Top row is the Night theme. Bottom row covers empty, offline and error.

The product has NO name yet ("Luna" is discarded). The mark is a neutral placeholder and there is deliberately no wordmark text: a stand-in name in an approved mock tends to stick.
Nothing in the build encodes a name. It arrives as one APP_BRAND value plus translation values, so naming it later touches no component.

DECIDED: the UI says "group" in English and "grupo" in Spanish. The CODE keeps saying zone, everywhere: the API, the enums, the routes and the contracts are unchanged.
So group is purely a translation value. Never rename a zone symbol in code to match the UI word.

The join request row names the FIRST requester, then adds "and X more want to join" only when there is more than one. The Home card shows the multi case; with a single request it reads "Ines wants to join".
